lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, forming approximately six identifiable horizontal rows within the mid-flank field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a structured matrix of anchor nodes along the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive labyrinthine or vermiculated patterning of high-luminance pixels located in the transitional area immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, preceding the stabilized grid pattern.
